heading: An honest room for an issue most men hide.
lead: Men of Integrity (MOI) is a Christian support group for men in Omaha and part of the Renewal ministry at Christ Community Church. We exist for men dealing with sexual brokenness, whether that's porn addiction, lust, or patterns you've tried to quit on your own and couldn't.
body: Shame thrives in secret. Healing happens in the light, alongside other men who get it. MOI gives you a safe place to be honest, connect with God in the middle of your struggle, and get practical tools you can use right away.
openNote: Open group. New men are welcome any Tuesday.
verse: "If we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus his Son cleanses us from all sin."
